R1074.evidence: Original raw-history suffix count cannot identify which entries emitted unread bytes:ignored releases and synthetic expansion break one-to-one count(P86 counterexample). Recording every raw key before dispatch keeps ordinal and receipt alignment without changing original ring payload.

R1075.problem: Select history by pending origin instead of raw suffix
R1075.evidence: P86 actual GetHistoryKeyEvent replaced alone by original compiles but fails ignored-release-after-unread-make:the last raw record is not necessarily the unread key. age maps selected live origins into original ring index;zero rejects unavailable/overwritten identities. Original wrap/index body remains.

R1076.problem: Reset origin state with original history reset
R1076.evidence: P88 restores only pinned original InitKeyHistory;return fixture fails because issued/output metadata survives while original raw history is empty. Subsequent selection could refer to an earlier handoff. Full zero reset is at the original init/return boundary;device metadata is already captured before controller reset.

R1077.problem: Let original EOI observe remaining relative fragments
R1077.evidence: Original MoreMouseEvents sees only absolute ring. Relative queue take fragments displacement into signed16-bit chunks:maintained bridge fixture demonstrates40000 becoming32767 then7233 while first take keeps the slot. DoMouseInterrupt counts submissions,not fragments;after its lazy count is exhausted,original EOI needs the remaining-queue predicate to schedule the next chunk.

R1078.evidence: Original MouseEoiHook(CallCount<0) zeroes lazy IRQ count and calls FlushMouseEvents. Restoring flush to absolute-ring-only leaves relative deltas/buttons queued after cancellation and can replay them on later input. Adapter cancel clears samples under existing ICA lock,preserves accepted frontend route,and wakes a producer blocked by full capacity. Maintained bridge tests cover cancellation and wake;not freshly rerun here.
R1078.plan: Remove explanatory comment;retain one cancel call pending owner. Do not reset connection ownership or require an extra ENTER.
